items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: David Jones and Thuttle got together and got that saxophone chromatic going up and down like that... David Jones would make the first part and he'd say, well Thuttle you take this.

ctx.x: You had the tippies, where did that come from?

I think that was, that was taken from Sidney, like I said, it was kind of high, and they used to call it, used to avoid, you're kind of tipsy when you're drunk, you know. It was, all those things come up about slang, you know. Yeah. Slang, yeah. And the other number, we just named like we was waking on Astor, we called that Astor, a strut. And what was the other one named? Duet Stump. Duet Stump, well Duet Stump is based, the chord changes, based on Sister Kate, but it's played in the fans' tempo. And David Jones…
One more question on the record. Who did the singing?
